links.note: No request: the link forms the source reads, with the name, point and precision each card takes from the link. The `?q=`, `?ll=`, `?address=` and `sll` forms are from Apple's Map Links reference; the `/place?…&coordinate=…&name=…` and `?address=…&auid=…&ll=…&q=…` forms are the Maps app's share links.
